name: Calpis
description: A lightly fermented milky soft drink with a subtle lactic tartness, diluted with water or soda and served chilled.
ingredients: a handful of fresh shiso leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine the panko breadcrumbs and chicken stock in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the wasabi paste and soy sauce, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with bonito flakes, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
Garnish with mitsuba just before serving.
Pour into your favorite glass or cup and enjoy.
tips: Adjust the sweetness gradually, tasting as you go — you can always add more bonito flakes, but you cannot take it away.
If serving warm, gently reheat just before pouring rather than letting it come to a boil.
